feeds.title: Blimey!
feeds.description: Established in 2006, BLIMEY! is a blog by Lew Stringer creator of Combat Colin, Tom Thug, Brickman, Derek the Troll and many more. This blog looks back at classic British comics and sometimes reports on current and upcoming titles.

feeds.title: Forbidden Planet International » Comics
feeds.description: News, Reviews and Interviews from the world of comics!

feeds.title: Get Your Comic On
feeds.description: Get Your Comic On started by 3 friends with a love for all things comics. Stay tuned for reviews of comics, games, films, TV shows, and more.

feeds.title: A Place to Hang Your Cape
feeds.description: A Place To Hang Your Cape is made by and for comic book fans of every kind. We cover everything from the British indie comics scene all the way up to Hollywood blockbusters. Whether it's superhero TV shows or films, comics of any kind, or even cosplay, we've got it all.

feeds.title: Steve Does Comics
feeds.description: Browse through Comic Book blatherings from the backyard of nostalgia. Explore my recollections of comic books incidents in various articles. I inflicted the novels 'Danny Yates Must Die,' 'Mr Landen Has No Brain' and 'Fatal Inheritance' on the world, as well as a bunch of short stories under a bunch of pseudonyms.

feeds.title: Bear Alley
feeds.description: Freelance author and editor for the past 20 years. My interests are old British comics, books and magazines... and that's what you'll find here.

feeds.title: Paul Gravett Blog
feeds.description: Paul Gravett is a London-based freelance journalist, curator, lecturer, writer, and broadcaster, who has worked in comics publishing and promotion since 1981. Explore the ever-changing worlds of Comics, Graphic Novels, and Manga.

feeds.title: 2000 AD
feeds.description: 2000 AD is the cutting edge powerhouse of British comics.Imaginative, hard-hitting stories and eye-popping art have made 2000 AD essential reading - from the violent satire of futuristic lawman Judge Dredd and the war-torn world of Rogue Trooper to the robot mayhem of the ABC Warriors and the stone-cold mutant killers of Strontium Dog.

feeds.title: Oink Blog
feeds.description: In 1986 I bought my first comic, OiNK! It introduced me to the world of comics and a few years back I decided to relive it issue-by-issue in real time, reading and reviewing each one on its original release date on my blog.

feeds.title: Get Your Comic On Blog » Comics
feeds.description: All posts relating to comic books. This section will include all news posts, press releases and reviews from across GYCO relating to comic books. Get Your Comic On' is a labour of love created by three friends.

feeds.title: Metro » DC Comics
feeds.description: The following section of Metro is dedicated to DC Comics. Featuring news, interviews, the latest release, and more. Metro brings you all the stories you need to know about Sport, Entertainment, Lifestyle, and more.

feeds.title: OK Comics Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates about comic book releases and events organized by us here. OK Comics is an independent Book Shop specialising in Graphic Novels and Comics. Every type of comic and graphic novel can be found at OK Comics, from great independent books to the latest superhero action adventure comics with everything in between. Popular genres here are crime, horror, biographies, history, gender issues, and music.

feeds.title: The Turnaround Blog
feeds.description: Turnaround has been distributing books in the UK and overseas since 1984. The blog is our place to share all this with you. Whether you're a bookseller, reviewer or a general book lover, stick around for regular book content on both brand-new releases and hidden gems. Plus exclusive extracts, author guest posts, interviews and more.

feeds.title: ComicScene
feeds.description: ComicScene Magazine presents a series of stories and plots on its page. Offering you a great deal of entertainment and also providing news and reports.

feeds.title: E-merl.com
feeds.description: My name is Daniel Merlin Goodbrey and everything you see here is my fault. I'm a comic creator and lecturer based out of Welwyn Garden City, England. E-merl.com is where I catalogue my experiments in fiction and the comics form.

feeds.title: Lew Stringer Comics
feeds.description: I am Lew Stringer. I have been working as a freelance artist and writer in British humour comics professionally since 1983. Clients include D.C. Thomson, Egmont, Marvel UK, IPC, Panini UK, Dark Horse Comics, Image Comics, and many more.

feeds.title: Boys Adventure Comics
feeds.description: Boys Adventure Comics is run by comics feature writer and archivist Richard Sheaf, who has written for a number of British comic magazines and websites, including Comic Scene and Downthetubes.

feeds.title: The Cartoon Museum Blog
feeds.description: In 1988 a group of cartoonists, collectors and lovers of the art form came together as The Cartoon Art Trust with the aim of founding a museum dedicated to collecting, exhibiting, promoting and preserving the best of British cartoon art. The Cartoon Museum shares some of the most interesting bits of information regarding the history of cartoons and comic art.

feeds.title: Magic Torch Comics Blog
feeds.description: Magic Torch Comics was developed from an art and heritage charity, which has been delivering community projects in Inverclyde for over 20 years. We work with schools, community groups and organisations to tell stories using comics. The website is full of work produced by the wonderful artists we have been lucky enough to work with including Mhairi M Robertson, Andy Lee, Norrie Millar, and more.

feeds.title: Peter Gray's Comics and Art
feeds.description: I'm a free-lance Pet Artist, Cartoonist, and Big UK humor comic fan.

feeds.title: Kazoop
feeds.description: Hi and welcome to my blog about comics from other people's childhood! It is dedicated primarily to British humour comics of the 60s and 70s. My intention is to use this blog as a channel for sharing my humble knowledge about different titles, favourite characters and creators as I slowly research my collection.

feeds.title: downthetubes.net
feeds.description: Founded in 1999, downthetubes.net is a web site dedicated to promoting comics, with a leaning toward British comic creators and publishers, large and small, but we'll happily report on other media, too.

feeds.title: Gosh Comics
feeds.description: With a 25-year track record in the industry and enthusiastic, knowledgeable staff, Gosh! Comics remains London's must-visit store for those who love the medium.

feeds.title: Treasury of British Comics
feeds.description: Treasury of British Comics is the world's largest archive of English-language comic books, bringing classic British comics back to life every month! Explore and read all and everything about comics - news, reports, interviews, and more.

feeds.title: Good Comics Blog
feeds.description: Good Comics is a UK-based independent publisher and distributor of comics, zines and graphic novels. Our aim is to nurture new talent in comics and bring new voices to the community of independent comics, in the UK and internationally. We're all about great stories, distinct voices, and unique talents.
